festivals.label: Elk Grove Lunar New Year Tết 2027

sections.core: Cash ops cover most of core (~$26K of ~$40K). Sponsor a core gift below to close the remaining gap — each unlocks stories for social posting.
sections.registry: Sponsor unlocks beyond core ops. High Priority stories match our Millennial-parent + Gen Alpha focus (kid-friendly required). Electives compete for the same sponsor dollars — pick the story you want to own.
sections.registryPriority: Kid-friendly experiences we lead with in asks — Children's Village, kids shows, carnival play, school youth, family photo decor. Still sponsor-funded; no funding guarantee.
sections.registryElective: Everything else on the registry — music blocks, heritage revue, parade, elders hospitality, evening modules, and more. Funded items run; unfunded ones wait.
sections.tiers: Recognition levels based on your total sponsorship. Tier benefits stack with any registry stories you fund — your build highlights the tier you reach.
sections.options: Sponsor booth spot unlocks at Bronze ($3,000+). Bring your own tent, or add tent rental. Tent rental requires sponsor booth spot.
